URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/netanyahu-to-meet-trump-at-white-house-next-week-amid-iran-war-escalation
(WebFetch — Al Jazeera, 24 July 2026)

Netanyahu will meet Trump at the White House next week (Tuesday), coinciding with attendance at Senator Lindsey Graham's funeral service.
Netanyahu's office statement: "At President Trump's invitation, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will depart for Washington on Monday for an official visit."
This marks Netanyahu's seventh White House visit during Trump's second term.

Military context: US Central Command completed its 13th consecutive night of strikes on Iran. Iran has conducted daily retaliatory strikes against US regional assets, including a strike that killed three American soldiers in Jordan.

Gaza casualty figures: At least 73,311 Palestinians killed in the conflict, with 1,185 deaths since the October ceasefire began.
West Bank: Four Palestinians killed Friday by Israeli forces and settlers near Nablus; 86 Palestinians killed across the occupied West Bank this year.
Trump (Truth Social): "Benjamin Netanyahu will not be arrested, in any way, shape, or form, while in the United States."
